The two ref files (handoff_refs/A.txt and B.txt) have identical generic text and give no file-specific priority. The pair gets 44 of the 60 minutes. radon/metrics.py:69-94 (halstead_visitor_report) holds the conversions. Line 79 has volume = N*log2(h) if h != 0 else 0. Line 80 has difficulty = (h1*N2)/float(2*h2) if h2 != 0 else 0. Line 81 has effort = difficulty*volume. Lines 93-94 have time = effort/18.0 and bugs = volume/3000.0. Those lines are the zero-count handling. One thing to check: log2(h) is 0 when h == 1, so volume is 0 there even though N > 0. radon/metrics.py:98-107 (mi_compute) also guards against volume <= 0 before taking log. radon/visitors.py builds the operator and operand counts that feed this code, so I would check how it handles empty or edge-case input. I did not read visitors.py. radon/complexity.py and radon/raw.py are not related to the Halstead calculations, so they get little time. The grep did not match either file.
